notes:
Fixed a dialogue timing issue in fixed-camera interviews. The camera subject now listens while the off-camera interviewer speaks. During answers, Workbench aligns the visible lips to the recorded voice and times closed-lip consonants against the English dialogue.

New interviews use the correction automatically. Open an earlier fixed-camera interview in Recent clips and choose **Repair dialogue sync** to make a new copy with the original voices and subtitles. The alignment data ships with the installer and works offline.
